evidence:
frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/news/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx imports useTranslation (:8) and uses t() for most copy, yet hardcodes several VISIBLE English strings that bypass i18n: `return
Please select an organization
` (:245), `return
Article not found
` (:264), the pinned badge `Pinned` (:274), and the view counter `{article.viewCount} views` (:294, both the ' views' label and the lack of locale number formatting).

ppt-web ships sk/cs/de/en locales, so Slovak/Czech/German users see English-only text for the no-org guard, the not-found state, the Pinned badge, and the view count on this wired customer-facing route. This is a cloud-landable frontend-only i18n gap.

NET-NEW: all prior signal mentions of ArticleDetailPage concern ONLY its dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink (2026-09-11 'ArticleDetailPage.tsx:331 ... is SAFE', 2026-09-23 same) or its endpoint auth (2026-08-29); none filed these rendered i18n gaps. No backlog.json row exists for news/article i18n.

Secondary (same file): the thrown load error `new Error(status === 404 ? 'Article not found' : 'Failed to load article')` (:57) is also an untranslated literal; if surfaced to the user it should map to a t('news.article.*') key.

Fix (frontend-only): route the four rendered strings through t('news.article.*') keys across en/sk/cs/de bundles and format viewCount with the active locale (reuse the shared number/formatDate util). Low severity, i18n gap on a wired surface.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/announcements/components/PinnedAnnouncementsBand.tsx:36 renders a hardcoded visible badge `Pinned` with no t() wrapping, in a component that otherwise imports useTranslation. The Pinned label is shown on every pinned-announcement chip and stays English for sk/cs/de users.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/news/components/NewsArticleCard.tsx:53 hardcodes the SVG accessibility label `<title>Pinned</title>`. This is screen-reader-facing text (announced by assistive tech) and must also be localized; it is an a11y + i18n gap on the news list card.

Same class as the ArticleDetailPage pinned badge above but in two distinct, independently-wired components (announcements band + news card), so filed separately for independent remediation. NET-NEW: no backlog.json row or prior signal names PinnedAnnouncementsBand or NewsArticleCard i18n.
Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): replace both literals with t('announcements.pinned') / t('news.pinnedLabel') (SVG <title> included) across en/sk/cs/de bundles. Low severity i18n/a11y gap.
